summary: Tested new phone+password + OTP auth (iteration 11). Backend pytest: 10 passed, 1 skipped (env limitation), 1 FAIL (seeded account 9000000001 missing in DB). Frontend E2E via Playwright: signup, OTP flow, password login, and wrong-password path all work; navigation to /app succeeds. Legacy session_token regression passes for customer+provider.

critical.issue: Seeded test account phone=9000000001 password=Test@1234 (documented in review request as pre-seeded) does NOT exist in MongoDB users collection. Login returns 401. Main agent should re-run the seed script or add an idempotent seeding step on startup.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout keys on request.client.host+phone. Behind k8s ingress the perceived client host rotates between pods (e.g., 10.208.134.74 vs 10.208.134.75), so 5-fail counter splits and 429 rarely triggers from external clients. Consider honoring X-Forwarded-For (leftmost) or keying only on phone with a slightly longer window.

action_items: Re-seed test account phone=9000000001 password=Test@1234 (name any, role=customer) or add an idempotent seed_test_users() to startup. Verified DB.users has no doc with login_phone=9000000001.
(Optional) Use X-Forwarded-For to compute stable client IP for _check_lock/_record_fail so lockout works behind ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _check_lock/_record_fail identifier uses request.client.host directly; behind k8s ingress this rotates. Suggest: identifier = (request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host) + ':' + phone.
server.py otp_verify: creates users with role='customer' — good (mobile accounts cannot become admin). No admin allowlist check needed here since role is hardcoded.

server.py otp_codes collection is written but code is never actually compared against the stored code, only against MOCK_OTP constant. When real provider is wired, verify path must read otp_codes[phone].code and expires_at.
AuthPanel.jsx uses sonner toasts for error display — good; no inline error markup, so ARIA/live-region for errors could be improved.
test_credentials: New created (per test run) or use OTP+any phone+123456. Seeded 9000000001/Test@1234 is MISSING; needs re-seeding.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests create ephemeral users with random phones (99XX + timestamp suffix). No cleanup done — tests are additive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_phone_otp_auth.py covers register (success/dup/short-pass), login (wrong pass, e2e with fresh user, seeded account), OTP (request/verify/wrong-code) and legacy session_token regression. Lockout test is soft-skipped because k8s ingress rotates source IPs; validate lockout manually from one IP if needed. Frontend Playwright test covered all three auth flows and confirmed navigation to /app.
rca of the issue: Seeded account absence: users.find_one({'login_phone':'9000000001'}) returns None. Either the seed step wasn't run, was run against a different DB_NAME, or was cleared. Fix: add idempotent upsert in startup or run scripts/seed_test_users.py. Verified via direct motor query against MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env.
